inspiration: The HUD is built from many small composable windows (gumps) in src/Gumps/: book, bulletin board, combat book, buff panel, custom house. Copy the modular pattern of one window per function, not the art.
The quest pointer is a screen-space arrow that points from the player to the objective, computed from the player position each frame (src/QuestArrow.cpp). It is a guide with no minimap needed.
Weather is a particle layer where each particle gets a random size from its ID (src/WeatherEffect.cpp). Cheap variety with no texture sheet.
The launcher uses one logo plus one icon set in several platform formats (client.ico, launcher.ico, crossuo.icns, launcher-icon.png). The same mark is shipped at every size.
A custom house builder shows a multi-tile preview object before placement (src/GUI/CustomHouseMultiObject.cpp). Its exact visuals were not read.
The custom cursor (resources/cursor.cur) is a small identity cue. Cheap to make, easy to recognise.
